items.title: Weekend evening motorbike limits around Hoan Kiem Lake
items.impact: From 7 PM to midnight Fri–Sun, petrol motorbikes are kept out of the lake's walking zone and the night market, through Dec 31. Grab bikes and cars aren't banned, but plan to walk the last stretch to the night market on Sat Dec 12.

items.title: Central coast is still in its rainy season
items.impact: Heavy rain hit central Vietnam in late October. The rain and flood season runs into December, and Hoi An's riverside streets flood in most years. Check the forecast the week before Dec 7; if the river is high, lantern boats may not run.
